d: Amit Shah launches a sharp attack on Rahul Gandhi over the INDIA bloc’s November 1 rally in Delhi, accusing Congress of hurting the sentiments of victims of the 1984 anti-Sikh riots. Recalling Rajiv Gandhi’s controversial “when a big tree falls, the ground shakes” remark, Shah questions the decision to hold the rally on the anniversary of the violence. He also mocks Rahul’s prime ministerial ambitions over the Opposition’s mock Parliament, declaring that his turn to become Prime Minister will never come.
